title: Action Center: recommendation cards, live diff preview, and safe-apply audit trail
creator: Maya Patel
description: Deliver a cohesive Action Center experience in the Console Optimize tab that surfaces automated batching and caching recommendations as compact recommendation cards, lets operators preview configuration diffs in a staged UI, and records an immutable apply history with rollback markers for safe revert. Goals: reduce time-to-apply optimizations, increase operator confidence through transparent diffs and rationale, and provide an auditable trail for compliance and debugging. Scope includes card design and content, rules for auto-generated recommendations (score/impact estimate + confidence), a live side-by-side diff preview that shows config changes and estimated cost/latency delta, apply workflow with safety checks, and an immutable apply history UI with exportable audit entries and rollback triggers. Does not include backend algorithm changes to recommendation heuristics beyond light metadata additions required for UI. Backend work (APIs, systems for immutable logs) will be tracked in ENG tickets and surfaced as dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards appear in Optimize Action Center for eligible routes and contain: title, short rationale, estimated monthly cost delta, expected latency impact, confidence score, and a CTA to Preview

Preview opens a side-by-side diff of current vs proposed configuration with line-level highlights and an estimated unit-cost calculation; preview can be toggled between token-cost and request-cost views
Apply flow requires a two-step confirmation, shows safety checks (compatibility, traffic percent for canary), and records an immutable audit entry upon success

Apply history page lists all applies for the tenant with timestamp, actor, config diff snapshot, applied model/quantization values, canary percentage, and a rollback action that re-applies the previous snapshot
Audit entries are exportable as JSON and include links to related GitHub PRs, console screenshots, and runtime metrics at time of apply
UX passes accessibility scan and basic usability testing with PM/Design/Eng sign-off

rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal beta for power users (1 week) with flag `optimize_action_center_beta`. Phase 2: Gradual tenant rollout to 10% of hosted accounts for 2 weeks. Phase 3: Full release and enable default for new accounts. Each apply will be gated by canary % and operator confirmation. Rollback is a manual trigger via audit entry; automated rollback will be considered in follow-up.
metrics: Time-to-apply reduction (median) from discovery to apply
Post-apply cost delta accuracy (est vs actual)
notes: Keep recommendation language conservative to avoid operator mistrust (phrase as 'suggested' with confidence).
Ensure preview computes cost estimates deterministically and includes last-6h baseline for comparison.
Talk to Solutions Eng about templates for enterprise tenants that require pre-approval workflows.
